# Louis Gustavo — Software Engineer

Canonical website: https://louisite.com
Language: English
Location: Indonesia

## Professional summary

Louis Gustavo is a Software Engineer at Traveloka with more than three years of experience building web interfaces and backend systems. His portfolio balances frontend and backend work rather than presenting him as limited to one layer. Technologies represented on the site include Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue.js, Node.js, Express, Laravel, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS, Terraform, and CI/CD tools.

## Verified background

- Software Engineer at Traveloka.
- Former Software Development Engineer intern at Blibli.com.
- Summa cum laude Computer Science graduate from BINUS University with a GPA of 3.94.
- Former Manager of the Web Development Division at HIMTI BINUS University.
- Recipient of the BINUS University Mentoring Scholarship Program for three consecutive semesters.
